stature.basis: Heritage: a French father of Quebec and an Ottawa mother (Andreas). Victoire's 1883 portrait in Andreas (p. 105) is of an old woman; not used for a girl. Height for age: the CDC 2000 stature-for-age table at the 5th centile for the age on 14 Aug 1812. Not a measurement. Why that centile: Steckel 1985 finds slave children below the first centile of modern standards and Komlos 2003 puts American apprentices of 14 at the 0.8th, while American adults reached about the 20th-30th; free children of a fed frontier household are set at the 5th.
